P01.description: Same-tree Linux PHP 8.4 full regression: 4093 passing, 29247 assertions, three fixture-export skips; 8 synthetic settings and 34 public browser cases; synthetic provider contracts. Not real provider/production login proof.

P02.description: Checked head and live merge have identical tree dfb891e7. Deploy reused passed exact-tree PR gates; final deploy Test/Build and Migration jobs were skipped, not rerun. Independent /ready confirms audited release.

P03.description: 22/22 coordinator GET/HEAD-only Chromium/WebKit cases at live release, including keyboard, dialogs, contrast, reduced motion, labels, responsive pages and electrician selection. No POST, production login or physical device.

P04.description: Fresh independent anonymous GET: exact /ready plus /up, canonical start/plans/explorer and parent site return 200. Offer/fee/industry markers; no submission or credentials retained.

P05.description: Current full CI includes fault injection for count/severity/recent queries, first failure, successful zero/nonzero, provenance/cache failure, sanitized evidence and non-operator denial; no live fault injection.

P06.description: Effective Marketplace flags all off and host unset; Teams rollout unchanged. 55 actual MySQL migration recovery cases/352 assertions and baseline/upgrade/concurrency checks pass. Private backup metadata is gzip-verified; no data restore/export or real provider acceptance.

P07.description: Fresh isolated SQLite :memory: exact-source fixture: canonical M entitlement resolves true, but signed-in catalog omits it and premium payload has only key/name. No HTTP sent. This is a settings ownership/readiness gap, not activation proof.

P08.description: Current source/README/runbook/test assertions reviewed against exact release. Source inventory is not hands-on coverage. Retired offer/deployed-state drift remains in entry points.

P09.description: Prior candidate local Lighthouse: accessibility 100 in 12 runs, mobile performance around59–61. Uncompressed loopback and simulated network do not prove final production/device performance; X3 remains unknown.

P10.description: Settings/role/tenant/price/wizard and electrician flag×intent cases included in final combined CI; browser settings use actual Blade exports with intercepted effects, not persistent production sessions.
